quarterly_data.signal: First three months of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (April-June 2026), consolidated: net sales JPY 39,019 million (+17.6% YoY), operating income JPY 10,505 million (+48.9%), ordinary income JPY 11,220 million (+68.5%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 7,500 million (+61.8%). Segment external sales / segment profit: Electronics JPY 28,049 million / JPY 9,761 million (prior-year quarter JPY 22,232 million / JPY 6,201 million); Medical and Pharmaceuticals JPY 9,203 million / JPY 772 million (JPY 9,419 million / JPY 1,378 million). Extraordinary losses of JPY 898 million in the quarter (special employee benefit expenses JPY 813 million; corporate action expenses JPY 84 million). TBF Semiconductor Material (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. was excluded from the scope of consolidation during the quarter.
